question: When can case-local schema be deleted
recommended_default: Do not delete until schema_ref runner and validator compatibility pass plus cleanup approval
risk_if_unresolved: Broken DB/checker execution or validator paths

question: When can case-local evidence be deleted
recommended_default: Do not delete without evidence_ref mapping and retention approval
notes: Retained evidence is not user-run output.

question: Does witness/ remain required
recommended_default: No static witness directory is optional unless case-specific policy requires it
notes: Runtime oracle should be source SQL result.

question: How should external evidence_ref be validated
recommended_default: Require path existence role classification and public hygiene checks
notes: Do not parse raw private evidence by default.

question: How to handle large retained result artifacts
recommended_default: Keep external and curated with mapping not case-local by default

question: How to support MySQL/Spark schema_ref
recommended_default: Validate engine-specific refs but implement execution separately
decision_needed_before: Any MySQL or Spark execution work
notes: Postgres remains the only DB/checker MVP engine.

question: How to keep user-run outputs separate
recommended_default: Keep output-root guard under runs/user and do not promote automatically
decision_needed_before: Any runner or evidence integration work
notes: User-run output is local diagnostic only.

question: How to clean-export construction audits
recommended_default: Classify audits and project-control files before public v0 export
